cases.excerpt: Cases were 767 patients (494 men and 273 women) with incident, histologically confirmed RCC; controls were 1,534 subjects (988 men and 546 women) admitted to the same hospitals as cases for a wide spectrum of acute, nonneoplastic conditions.

effect_size.excerpt: After allowing for energy and other major covariates, a significant inverse association was found for vitamin E (odds ratio, OR, for the highest quintile of intake versus the lowest one 0.56, 95% confidence interval, CI 0.41-0.75), and vitamin C (OR = 0.72, 95% CI = 0.54-0.96), although the trend in risk for vitamin C was of borderline significance.
